system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: Lucy Park launched Remote Desktop from WS-LPARK-01 toward DC-HD-01; the endpoint records show an attempted outbound connection to the domain controller, but do not establish that the RDP session succeeded.
Lucy Park also launched Remote Desktop toward FILE-HD-01, and FILE-HD-01 recorded a successful remote-interactive logon for her from WS-LPARK-01.
The RDP activity is anomalous against the supplied practice that remote administration is only performed from WS-OHADDAD-01; the records show Lucy's workstation as the RDP source.
At 13:42:09 UTC, Dropbox.exe started under Lucy Park's account. A loaded Dropbox DLL is reported as validly signed; the records do not show whether Dropbox synced or transferred data.
Lucy Park's workstation accessed Slack through Chrome shortly before the alert time. This establishes access, not malicious use or data transfer.

known_telemetry_limitations: Both winsec and sysmon collection for DC-HD-01 were unavailable from 13:30 through 14:10 UTC, including the alert's stated account-creation time.
The supplied records contain no domain-controller account-creation or group-membership event for tmp.rwong.
The supplied endpoint and proxy records do not establish a successful RDP session to DC-HD-01, Dropbox synchronization, or a GlobalProtect connection.
claims_not_established: Whether tmp.rwong was created as described in the alert, who created it, or whether its creation was authorized.
Whether tmp.rwong was added only to Temp-Staff or received other group membership or privileges.
Whether Lucy Park successfully accessed DC-HD-01 or performed the account creation.
Whether the Dropbox process transferred organizational data, or whether Slack was used to share data.
Whether the observed activity was performed by Lucy Park or by another person using her account.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain DC-HD-01 security and directory-service audit logs for the outage window, especially account creation, group membership, privilege changes, and logon events around 13:42 UTC.
Verify tmp.rwong's creation time, creator, enabled status, group membership, privileges, and any subsequent authentication from authoritative directory and domain-controller records.
Correlate RDP logon/session records on DC-HD-01 and FILE-HD-01 with Lucy Park's account and workstation.
Check WS-LPARK-01 for Dropbox configuration, sync history, transferred files, and network telemetry; determine whether the installation or use was authorized.
Review any available GlobalProtect connection logs and other endpoint evidence to determine whether a remote-access session was established.
